sources.colours: the Elwynn pack (schema 15, ai2 tmp/elwynn-store-15), light_set 1 (map 0's default volume): the `sun` and `ambient` columns, decoded as the client does (0x00RRGGBB sRGB, client/client/src/adapter.rs decode), here in linear RGB
sources.sun elevation at noon: about 73 degrees: the client's sky settings, latitude 40, axial tilt 23.44, day 172 (client/sky/src/settings.rs defaults)
sources.low sun elevation: 15 degrees, under the 20 at which the client's sun reaches full light (full_light_deg) and the angle that showed WI 2091's facets
sources.strengths: Blender sun strength and world strength set by the calibration against WI 2091's in-game captures (WI 2092 code.md)
